core_meaning.primary_meaning: Kasam corresponds to the Arabic form قسم and is glossed in this record as “Oath, vow, sworn pledge.” The record associates the form with root ق س م (q-s-m). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Kasam corresponds to the Arabic form قسم (Arabic root ق س م (q-s-m); قَسَم (Qasam)). Its core sense is oath, vow, sworn pledge. Kasam is Arabic قَسَم (Qasam) 'oath, vow, sworn pledge', from the root ق س م (q-s-m). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave كسام (a different form) and glossed the name 'Promise, Commitment'; the correct form is قَسَم. Recorded at medium confidence because the word is primarily a common noun.

persian.name: قسم
